renew_elems=driver.find_elements(AppiumBy.XPATH, '//*[@resource-id="org.tasks:id/title" and contains(@text,"Renew Driver")]')
wed_due=[e for e in driver.find_elements(AppiumBy.ID,'org.tasks:id/due_date') if e.text=='Wed' and parse_bounds(e.get_attribute('bounds'))[1]>1700]
if len(wed_due)!=2: raise RuntimeError(f'Unexpected lower Wednesday due count {len(wed_due)}')
# License row aligns with the first lower Wednesday due; Marketing is the second.
y_due=parse_bounds(wed_due[0].get_attribute('bounds'))[1]
candidates=[e for e in renew_elems if abs(parse_bounds(e.get_attribute('bounds'))[1]-y_due)<30]
if len(candidates)!=1: raise RuntimeError(f'Expected one aligned license row, found {len(candidates)}')
candidates[0].click()
WebDriverWait(driver,5).until(lambda d: any(e.get_attribute('class')=='android.widget.EditText' for e in d.find_elements(AppiumBy.ID,'org.tasks:id/title')))
root=ET.fromstring(driver.page_source)
radios=[{'checked':n.attrib.get('checked'),'bounds':n.attrib.get('bounds')} for n in root.iter() if n.attrib.get('class')=='android.widget.RadioButton']
dateTexts=[n.attrib.get('text') for n in root.iter() if n.attrib.get('text') and ('Wednesday' in n.attrib.get('text') or 'October' in n.attrib.get('text'))]
